title: Specialist Generator Output Schema v3.2
description: Same five-role field structure as the frozen Generator schema; Specialist route additionally pins the exact selected role. Controls retain frozen schema and prompts. Invalid plans are rejected before generation; Generator has no error/null output variant.

role.description: The five-role output structure is preserved for compatibility; the Specialist route pins the exact assigned Specialist constant. STATIC/automatic GENERALIST use control_50; requested GENERALIST uses its frozen separate route.

message.description: One intervention with optional sections, paragraphs and numbered lists. Runtime word ceiling across all visible text including titles and list numbers: 55 English words for Synthesiser and 50 for Expander/Challenger. No sentence, section or point-count cap.

groundingMessageIds.description: 本条干预所依据的、已在讨论中公开分享的消息 ID 列表。若干预不依赖具体消息（如通用开放性问题），可为空数组，但不可省略该字段。
